name: BigQuery
description: Typed BigQuery datasets, tables, jobs, bounded query results, dry runs, explicit streaming inserts, routines, models and projects.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS BigQuery REST v2 calls at bigquery.googleapis.com with encrypted OAuth token. Confirmed effects include metadata changes, billable SQL jobs/queries, streaming rows, cancellation and deletes. Alternative tokenSecret needs host authorization. No filesystem/ambient credentials or automatic retries.

definitions.name: Get BigQuery Dataset
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Dataset
definitions.documentation: Get BigQuery Dataset: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Get BigQuery Job
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Job
definitions.documentation: Get BigQuery Job: GET /projects/{projectId}/jobs/{jobId}. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Request BigQuery Job Cancellation
definitions.description: Request BigQuery Job Cancellation
definitions.documentation: Request BigQuery Job Cancellation: POST /projects/{projectId}/jobs/{jobId}/cancel. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CANCEL_JOB. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Get BigQuery Routine
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Routine
definitions.documentation: Get BigQuery Routine: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/routines/{routineId}. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. definitions.name: Get BigQuery Service Account (Direct)
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Service Account
definitions.documentation:
Get BigQuery Service Account: GET /projects/{projectId}/serviceAccount. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: List BigQuery Datasets (Direct)
definitions.description: List BigQuery Datasets
definitions.documentation:
List BigQuery Datasets: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.description: Create BigQuery Dataset
definitions.documentation:
Create BigQuery Dataset: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_DATASET. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2 https://bigquery.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v2 https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tables https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/query https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/getQueryResults https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/QueryParameter https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/insertAll https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/list https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/models https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/running-queries#dry-run https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/authentication https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/TableReference https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/Job https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/python-bigquery/main/tests/unit/job/test_query.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/python-bigquery/main/tests/unit/job/helpers.py

definitions.name: Patch BigQuery Dataset Metadata (Direct)
definitions.description: Patch BigQuery Dataset Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Patch BigQuery Dataset Metadata: PATCH /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PATCH_DATASET. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Delete BigQuery Dataset (Direct)
definitions.description: Delete BigQuery Dataset
definitions.documentation:
Delete BigQuery Dataset: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_DATASET. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.description: List BigQuery Tables
definitions.documentation:
List BigQuery Tables: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Get BigQuery Table (Direct)
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Table
definitions.documentation:
Get BigQuery Table: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation:
Create BigQuery Table: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_TABLE. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2 https://bigquery.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v2 https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tables https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/query https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/getQueryResults https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/QueryParameter https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/insertAll https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/list https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/models https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/running-queries#dry-run https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/authentication https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/TableReference https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/Job https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/python-bigquery/main/tests/unit/job/test_query.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/python-bigquery/main/tests/unit/job/helpers.py

definitions.name: Patch BigQuery Table Metadata (Direct)
definitions.description: Patch BigQuery Table Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Patch BigQuery Table Metadata: PATCH /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PATCH_TABLE. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. Delete BigQuery Table: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_TABLE. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: List BigQuery Jobs (Direct)
definitions.description: List BigQuery Jobs
definitions.documentation:
List BigQuery Jobs: GET /projects/{projectId}/jobs. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Submit BigQuery Query Job (Direct)
definitions.description: Submit BigQuery Query Job
definitions.documentation:
Submit BigQuery Query Job: POST /projects/{projectId}/jobs. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=SUBMIT_QUERY_JOB. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. Dry Run BigQuery Query: POST /projects/{projectId}/jobs. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Run BigQuery Query Once (Direct)
definitions.description: Run BigQuery Query Once
definitions.documentation:
Run BigQuery Query Once: POST /projects/{projectId}/queries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=RUN_QUERY. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2 https://bigquery.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v2 https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tables https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/query https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/getQueryResults https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/QueryParameter https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/insertAll https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/list https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/models https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/running-queries#dry-run https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/authentication https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/TableReference https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/Job https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/python-bigquery/main/tests/unit/job/test_query.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleapis/python-bigquery/main/tests/unit/job/helpers.py

definitions.name: Get BigQuery Query Results (Direct)
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Query Results
definitions.documentation:
Get BigQuery Query Results: GET /projects/{projectId}/queries/{jobId}. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: List BigQuery Table Rows (Direct)
definitions.description: List BigQuery Table Rows
definitions.documentation:
List BigQuery Table Rows: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}/data. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Stream BigQuery Row Batch (Direct)
definitions.description: Stream BigQuery Row Batch
definitions.documentation:
Stream BigQuery Row Batch: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}/insertAll. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=STREAM_INSERT. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.description: List BigQuery Routines
definitions.documentation:
List BigQuery Routines: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/routines. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation:
Delete BigQuery Routine: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/routines/{routineId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_ROUTINE. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. definitions.name: List BigQuery Models (Direct)
definitions.description: List BigQuery Models
definitions.documentation:
List BigQuery Models: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/models. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation:
Delete BigQuery Model: DELETE /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/models/{modelId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_MODEL. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation.
